subject: BrightLane customer spotlight — incentive selection and donation evidence
messages:
From: Claire Donovan <claire@brightlane.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Ellis <mark.ellis@brightlane.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Customer spotlight / incentive questions

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the invite — we'd be happy to participate in a short customer spotlight about our use of Redwood. Two quick questions on incentives and procurement:

1) Are we able to split the thank-you between a credit on our account and a charity donation (we'd like to donate to the BrightLane Foundation)? If so, can you provide a receipt that our finance team can file?

2) For swag options, do you have a catalog or size chart? We have a few folks who want tees and stickers.

I'll loop in Mark (ops) for procurement details if we need a PO. We want to get the spotlight scheduled next month if possible.

Best,
Claire Donovan
Head of Partnerships, BrightLane

------------------------------------------------------------
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Claire Donovan <claire@brightlane.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer spotlight / incentive questions

Hi Claire — great to hear you're interested. We can absolutely split the incentive. Typical approaches we offer:

- Account credit (applied as a promo code or invoice credit)
- Direct donation to a registered charity (we provide a PDF receipt with donor name and amount)
- Swag fulfillment (tees, stickers, laptop sleeve) shipped to a provided address

I've attached our swag options PDF for quick picks (see attachment).

Next steps I propose:
- Tell us the split you prefer (credit vs donation) and the full legal name for the donation receipt (BrightLane Foundation? taxable entity?)
- If a credit, do you prefer it as an account promo code or a vendor invoice credit?
- For swag, provide shipping address and each recipient's size if you want tees.

Rishi (cc'd) will handle the credit application; Monica will handle swag fulfillment and the donation paperwork. If Mark prefers a PO route for any of this, I can route to our billing team — just say the word.

We can have donation evidence and credit applied within 48 hours once you confirm. Also happy to put this into HubSpot/DocuSign if you need an approval flow.

Thanks — excited to feature BrightLane.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: swag_options_2026-07.pdf (application/pdf, 210 KB)

From: Claire Donovan <claire@brightlane.com>

Cc: Mark Ellis <mark.ellis@brightlane.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer spotlight / incentive questions

Thanks, Vanessa — that all sounds good.

We'd like the following split: $500 account credit, $250 donation to BrightLane Foundation. Please make the donation receipt out to "BrightLane Foundation, EIN: 27-1234567" (this is the foundation we use for corporate giving).

For swag: two medium tees, one large tee, and six sticker sheets — ship to the address below (BrightLane HQ — Attn: Office Ops).

If you need a PO for the credit, our procurement email is procurement@brightlane.com and Mark can approve. Otherwise, if you can apply the credit as a promo code, that's fine.

Can you confirm timeline and when we can expect the receipt? We need it for our monthly finance close.

Claire
